instructions: A to-do's status moves only through the transition verbs; update_todo cannot change it. start_todo when work begins, complete_todo when it is finished, cancel_todo when it will not be done, block_todo with a reason when it is waiting on something, reopen_todo to put it back to open. archive_todo only hides a to-do and leaves its status as it is. A to-do's key (MAG-3) and a board's key (MAG) work anywhere an id does. Hosts that load skills can read skill://todos/SKILL.md for more.

resource_templates.description: The To-dos app UI under a build key. Every key serves the current build.
resource_templates.name: todos_ui_build

resources.description: Manage work on a board. Create and decompose to-dos, move them through the fixed status lifecycle, and read board state.
resources.name: todos

resources.description:
The To-dos board UI: static HTML, holding no data, that an MCP Apps host renders in a frame.

Serving it reads a file and opens no database session, so the board loads (and can show
an error) even when the database cannot be reached. Every datum it shows is fetched at
runtime through the host's tool calls, which carry the caller's identity.
resources.name: todos_ui

tools.description:
Hide a to-do from default views, leaving its status as it is.

Archiving is not finishing: a finished to-do is complete_todo, one that will not be
done is cancel_todo. Nothing un-archives a to-do; list_todos(include_archived=True)
still finds it.

todo_id.description: The to-do to archive (required, in-scope): its id or its key (e.g. MAG-3).

tools.name: archive_todo
tools.title: Archive Todo

tools.description:
Mark a to-do blocked: it is waiting on something outside it (a person, a review).

Records ``reason`` as ``blocked_reason``; get_next_todo skips blocked to-dos. When the
blocker clears, start_todo resumes it, or reopen_todo puts it back to open.

reason.description: Why it is blocked (required) — stored as ``blocked_reason``.

todo_id.description: The to-do to block (required, in-scope): its id or its key (e.g. MAG-3).

tools.name: block_todo
tools.title: Block Todo

tools.description:
Mark a to-do cancelled: it will not be done. Sets ``completed_at``; takes no reason.

If the work was finished, use complete_todo instead; to hide a to-do without changing
its status, archive_todo. reopen_todo undoes it.

todo_id.description: The to-do to cancel (required, in-scope): its id or its key (e.g. MAG-3).

tools.name: cancel_todo
tools.title: Cancel Todo

tools.description:
Mark a to-do done: the work is finished. Sets ``completed_at``.

If it will not be done, use cancel_todo instead; to only hide it, archive_todo.
reopen_todo undoes it.

todo_id.description: The to-do to complete (required, in-scope): its id or its key (e.g. MAG-3).

tools.name: complete_todo
tools.title: Complete Todo

tools.description:
Create a board. ``columns`` defaults to the four canonical lanes.

The board's key prefixes its to-dos' keys (MAG-1, MAG-2, ...) and cannot change later.
Tell the person the key the result carries.

columns.description:
Ordered presentation overlay [{key, label, status, color?, wip_limit?}];
defaults to Open / Doing / Blocked / Done.

key.description:
The board's key: 2-5 letters A-Z or digits, starting with a letter, unused in
the workspace. Omit to derive one from the name ("Launch plan" → LP).

tools.name: create_board
tools.title: Create Board

tools.description:
Add one to-do. For several, or one goal broken into steps, use plan_todos instead.

Omit ``board_id`` and it lands on the workspace's default board, created on first use.
It starts ``open`` unless ``status`` says otherwise; after that its status moves only
through start_todo, complete_todo, block_todo, reopen_todo and cancel_todo.

assignee.description: Who it is for: agent, a person's handle, or any name.

blocked_reason.description:
Why it is blocked. Required when status is blocked, and taken only
then.

board_id.description:
Target board, its id or its key (e.g. MAG); defaults to the auto-created
workspace default board.

idempotency_key.description:
Optional retry-dedupe token. A retried create with the SAME
key on the SAME board converges to one row instead of duplicating.

parent_id.description: Optional parent to-do (id or key, e.g. MAG-3) for step decomposition.

priority.description:
urgent, high, normal (the default) or low. Any other value is kept and
ranks after low.

tools.name: create_todo
tools.title: Create Todo

tools.description:
A board's health: per-lane counts, totals, and what needs attention.

A lane with a WIP limit says whether it is within it; attention lists the overdue,
stalled and blocked to-dos. Start here to report on a board, then name the to-dos behind the counts.

board_id.description:
The board to summarize, its id or its key (e.g. MAG); omit for the
workspace default board.

tools.name: get_board_summary
tools.title: Get Board Summary

tools.description:
The to-do to work on next: the highest-priority open, unarchived to-do.

Blocked, in-progress and finished to-dos are skipped. Use it for "what should I do
next" rather than listing to-dos and choosing.

board_id.description:
Restrict to one board, by its id or its key (e.g. MAG); omit to consider
every actionable to-do across all boards in the workspace.

tools.name: get_next_todo
tools.title: Get Next Todo

tools.description:
Get a to-do with its steps, counts, and recent activity timeline.

The to-do comes whole, ``details`` included. Each step is a row with a
``details_preview`` in place of ``details``; read a step whole with its own get_todo.

todo_id.description: The to-do's id or its key (e.g. MAG-3), required.

tools.name: get_todo
tools.title: Get Todo

tools.description:
List the workspace's boards, each with its id, key and lanes.

Use it to find a board's id or key. For one board's counts and what needs attention
use get_board_summary; for the to-dos on it, list_todos.
tools.name: list_boards
tools.title: List Boards

tools.description:
List or search to-dos, with optional filters and cursor pagination.

Without ``query`` the newest come first. With ``query``, only to-dos whose title or
details contain every word of it are listed, best match first: exact title, then
title starting with the query, then every word starting a title word, then the rest,
newest first within each. Rows carry a short ``details_preview``, not ``details``:
pick from the previews, then read the to-do you act on whole with ``get_todo``.

board_id.description: Filter to one board, by its id or its key (e.g. MAG).

cursor.description:
Opaque pagination cursor from a previous page of the same call; pass the
same filters and query with it.

include_archived.description: Include archived to-dos (default False hides them).

label.description: Filter to to-dos carrying this label.

parent_id.description: Filter to a goal's steps (the goal's id or key).

query.description:
Search text over title and details, split on whitespace; every word must
match, case-insensitively, as a substring. Combines with the other filters.

tools.name: list_todos
tools.title: List Todos

tools.description:
Add several to-dos in one call: a plan, or one goal broken into steps.

For a single to-do use create_todo. It only adds: the to-dos already on the board are
never replaced or removed, so it is safe on a board a person also edits. Pass
``parent_id`` to group the steps under a goal, and ``idempotency_key`` so a retried call
returns the same to-dos instead of adding them twice.

board_id.description:
Target board, its id or its key (e.g. MAG); defaults to the workspace
default board (auto-created).

idempotency_key.description:
Optional call-level key; per-item keys derive from it + index
so a re-run of the plan converges.

parent_id.description: Optional shared parent to-do (id or key) grouping every step under one goal.

todos.description:
The steps, in order, each {title, details?, priority?, labels?, due_at?,
status?, blocked_reason?}.

blocked_reason.description: Why the step is blocked. Required when status is blocked, and taken only then.

priority.description: urgent, high, normal (the default) or low. Any other value is kept and ranks after low.

status.description: The step's starting status; default open. done and cancelled set completed_at; blocked needs blocked_reason.

tools.name: plan_todos
tools.title: Plan Todos

tools.description:
Put a to-do back to open: it was done, cancelled or blocked, and is to do again.

Clears ``completed_at`` and ``blocked_reason``. Use it rather than create_todo when
finished work comes back; to resume work right away, use start_todo.

todo_id.description: The to-do to reopen (required, in-scope): its id or its key (e.g. MAG-3).

tools.name: reopen_todo
tools.title: Reopen Todo

tools.description:
Set the order of the to-dos in one status lane of a board, to reprioritize them.

It changes positions only. To move a to-do to another status, use start_todo,
complete_todo, block_todo, reopen_todo or cancel_todo.

board_id.description: The board whose lane is reordered (required, in-scope): its id or its key.

status.description: The lane to reorder, by its status.

todo_ids.description: Every to-do in the lane (ids or keys), in the new order.

tools.name: reorder_todos
tools.title: Reorder Todos

tools.description:
Mark a to-do in progress: work on it has begun.

Clears any ``blocked_reason``, so it also resumes a blocked to-do once the blocker is
gone. When the work is finished use complete_todo; when it is stuck, block_todo.

todo_id.description: The to-do to start (required, in-scope): its id or its key (e.g. MAG-3).

tools.name: start_todo
tools.title: Start Todo

tools.description:
Change a board's name, description or lanes. Its key never changes.

Only the fields you pass change. Null or an empty name or description leaves it as
it is, so neither can be cleared here. Editing ``columns`` changes which status each
lane shows; no to-do's status changes.

board_id.description: The board to update (required, in-scope): its id or its key (e.g. MAG).

columns.description:
The whole new lane list, replacing the old: [{key, label, status, color?,
wip_limit?}], each lane showing the to-dos in one status. Omit to keep the
lanes; an empty list leaves the board with none.

description.description: The new description. Omit to keep it.

name.description: The new name. Omit to keep it.

tools.name: update_board
tools.title: Update Board

tools.description:
Change a to-do's title, details, priority, labels, assignee, due date or goal.

Not its status: to move a to-do, use start_todo, complete_todo, block_todo,
reopen_todo or cancel_todo. Only the fields you pass change. Null or an empty value
leaves a field as it is, so no field can be cleared here.

assignee.description: Who it is for: agent, a person's handle, or any name. Omit to keep it.

details.description: New markdown details, replacing the old. Omit to keep them.

due_at.description: The new due time (ISO-8601). Omit to keep it.

labels.description:
The whole new label list, replacing the old. Omit (or pass an empty list)
to keep the labels.

parent_id.description:
The goal this to-do becomes a step of, by id or key; not the to-do
itself. Omit to keep it.

priority.description:
urgent, high, normal or low; any other value is kept and ranks after low.
Omit to keep it.

title.description: The new title. Omit to keep it.

todo_id.description: The to-do to update (required): its id or its key (e.g. MAG-3).

tools.name: update_todo
tools.title: Update Todo
